scope: ThreePhaseGenerator only; ordinary single-pass generator unchanged
context_selection: All three phases fixed at 65536; each final template-applied prompt plus 4096 output tokens must fit. Legacy context tier settings do not select the three-phase window.
history_text_policy: final responses only; user requests are not retained in the collector projection or model display; missing, unsafe or over-budget final responses omit the record
prefill_policy: Full template-applied input >12000 tokens: synchronize and clear unused allocator cache after every prefill chunk, including common-prefix preparation. <=12000: omit these extra synchronization/reclaim calls. Retain required cache evaluation.

prefix_reuse.plan: automatic token-prefix comparison, no external token plan
prefix_reuse.copy: immutable snapshot and independent runtime copies
prefix_reuse.fallback: unknown cache type, settings or token-prefix mismatch uses ordinary prefill

limitations: Production retains the existing optional codex_context source and path association; this change does not connect the separate agent-history content-attribution PoC
Qwen and Gemma installed-model checks use one synthetic file, not the 7/9/11-file quality benchmark
Revision 2 is not byte-identical to historical private requests: the new 48-character instruction and natural dictionary ordering are intentional
Cache reuse is not proof of numerical or semantic equivalence; earlier Qwen Text differences remain unresolved
No CI result or main merge is asserted by this local registration
12000 is a provisional boundary; this implementation does not establish optimality or a speed/quality improvement

input_token_counting.operation: count_only on the same sequential helper process before generation
input_token_counting.coverage: same model, literal-newline display, system/phase/schema and chat template as generation; includes reused prefix
input_token_counting.side_effects: no grammar preparation, prefill, sampling, prefix snapshot changes or phase advancement
input_token_counting.failure: stop on count failure; omit optional final-only history records that cannot fit; reject mandatory overflow
input_token_counting.transport_limits: unchanged; byte frame and retained-history limits remain resource bounds, not token estimates
